record.title: Compare private exclusive operations with and without instruction stepping
record.intent: Isolate observer-induced retries before changing the stock application observation boundary.
requirements: Fresh disposable pinned guest; no Sparrow installation, launch or device responses in this experiment.
Use the same private single-thread program and binary with fixed inputs for both observation modes.
No stock artifact, host policy, physical instrument or guest enforcement changes.
Bound the atomic loop to eight attempts and the observer to 128 single steps plus a terminal stop.
Preserve unexpected outcomes; do not extend bounds to obtain a desired result.
acceptance: Pin source, binary, guest inputs and uninterrupted versus stepped arm order.
Capture initial and terminal word, attempts, exclusive-store status, PC and signal metadata.
Independently verify instruction traces, control flow, finite bounds and same code across arms.
Verify stable system_server, guest enforcement and teardown.
